label: Euclid/Euclid DR1/MER/Morphology (Deep Survey)
name: Euclid DR1 MER Morphology - Deep Survey
description: Euclid is a space-based survey observatory launched by the European Space Agency (ESA) in July 2023, which aims to map the large-scale structure of the Universe to better understand dark energy and dark matter. The first stage of Data Release 1 (DR1 Foundation) was released on 12 November 2026. This is the DR1 table mer_morphology_deep_survey from the MER (merged mosaics and object catalogue) products, with 51,820,952 rows, converted to HATS by IRSA.
